program.name: Bell Pilates Volume
program.subject: Kettlebell Pilates
program.blurb: Three long Pilates sessions with a light kettlebell: core, glutes and legs, back and sides.
program.about: Pilates with a light kettlebell in your hands. Bell roll-ups, chest lifts and teasers for the core; bell bridges and plié pulses for the glutes and legs; bell saws, twists and side-lying lifts for the back and sides. Mat moves fill between. Three days rotate. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Bell core / bell glutes & legs / bell back & sides
